name: Point Implicit Contouring (PIC)
definition: A voxel terrain storage format that stores a dense 3D array of voxels and a sparse 3D array of points. The points become vertices of the surface mesh, and their connectivity is implicitly derived from the voxel data (signs or material indices at cell corners).
summary: Point Implicit Contouring is a sparse voxel format that derives mesh connectivity implicitly from voxel data, distinguishing itself by supporting surface smoothing and eliminating the need for post-editing regularization.
